prompt:

Asset type: one Genshin Impact Genius Invokation TCG style card-bottom status icon for Eula's Grimheart / 冷酷之心.

Remove the two upward chevrons at the lower right; do not include any arrows or buff-direction marks.
Reference image 2, IceLotus.png, is style only: match its dark blue outline, icy blue/white highlights, readable sculpted shadow facets and restrained painted card-game icon finish; do not include the lotus-flower subject.
Render the Eula crest as a compact icy blue and silver-white solid emblem, with deep cyan/blue recessed regions and broad controlled highlight/shadow bands. Fill all interior negative spaces with opaque dark blue backing so there are no transparent holes inside the emblem. Keep the official flared crest recognizable and clear at small UI size. Abstract ornamental icon, not realistic, no scenery or weapon model.
Centered on a square canvas, whole crest fits inside a roughly circular footprint with generous transparent margins. No enclosing circular frame, no text, numbers, count badge, arrows, watermark or extra symbols. Actual transparent background outside the solid crest.
